@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+### Fixed
+
+- Retry explicit internal GitHub commit_refs_rules and HTTP 429/5xx push failures at most three times with backoff; preserve policy refusals and diagnostics (`RELEASE_DEBUG=1`).
+- Retain the validated release SHA, reject source or dependency drift across remote recovery and rebases, and adopt only verified metadata-only release children. Compare the entire repository and parsed TOML/uv lock content in both Python layouts.

@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+### Fixed
+
+- Reject CodeQL execution/configuration warnings, errors and malformed notifications even when the invocation succeeds and reports no findings. Include diagnostic descriptors, locations and messages in gate failures.

@@ -52,9 +52,32 @@ CodeQL uses full analysis for both Python and Actions. The job-level
 300-file truncation without changing query selection. The official analyzer
 still uploads to Code Scanning, then `scripts/check_codeql_results.py` checks
 every local SARIF report/run and fails on every finding regardless of severity,
-invalid reports, or failed invocations. Reports are uploaded even when the gate
+invalid reports, or failed invocations. Every invocation's execution and
+configuration notifications are checked even when execution succeeds and the
+findings list is empty. Errors, warnings (including the SARIF default when level
+is omitted), unknown levels, malformed records and malformed arrays fail the
+gate, with descriptor, location and message context. Valid note/none
+notifications remain informational. Reports are uploaded even when the gate
 fails. The aggregate Security status therefore observes these failures directly.
 
 The link checker accepts actual live-link recovery, but archive snapshots are
 repair suggestions. A failed checker cannot pass without usable report evidence.
 The archive helper fails closed when its report is missing or unusable.
+
+Manual releases carry `VALIDATED_SHA` from the workflow event through versioning
+and push recovery. The release helper accepts that commit or a direct child
+whose full repository tree differs only in release metadata: `project.version`,
+the matching local package version in `uv.lock`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and deletion of
+collected `changelog.d/*.md` fragments (excluding README). All other manifest,
+lock, source and file-mode changes require CI on the new revision. A verified
+remote release child is adopted into a clean checkout before building; matching
+version strings alone never establish recovery. Existing uv locks are refreshed
+with `uv lock --offline`, and dependency drift fails attestation.
+
+Explicit `fatal error in commit_refs_rules` and HTTP 429/5xx push failures retry
+the unchanged commit at most three times, waiting 1 and 2 seconds. GH006/GH013
+repository policy failures remain permanent, even when mixed with transient
+text. Every failed push response is retained in the log; `RELEASE_DEBUG=1` adds
+attempt/classification details. Lost races validate the remote before recovery
+and attest the resulting commit before any subsequent push. No force push or
+repository rule bypass is used.

+# Issue 138: requirements, research and verification plan
+
+Read scope: parent #138, native children #136/#137, all issue comments,
+PR #139 conversation/inline comments/reviews (none initially), latest merged
+PR #134, downstream sensitive-data-sanitizer #93 and link-cli #166.
+
+## Requirement inventory and selected solutions
+
+| Requirement | Implementation plan | Verification |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| #136 exact internal `fatal error in commit_refs_rules` and explicit HTTP 429/5xx | Classify transient before races, after policy refusals | parameterized classifications, recovery tests |
+| At most three unchanged pushes with backoff | Existing bounded loop, exponential sleeps only for transient failures | identical arguments, two sleeps, no pull/rebase |
+| GH006/GH013 remain permanent, no bypass/force | Keep policy precedence and immediate exit | mixed-error tests |
+| Preserve stderr; default-off classification/attempt diagnostics | Print each failed response; opt-in `RELEASE_DEBUG=1` | captured output tests |
+| #136 comment: retain validated SHA | Workflow passes immutable event SHA; local fallback captures starting HEAD | workflow and real Git tests |
+| Accept only validated checkout or attested metadata-only child | Require sole direct parent, compare entire Git tree including modes | source drift, parent loss, merge/extra child tests |
+| Matching/different version is insufficient; compare parsed manifest/lock | Ignore only project.version and matching local uv package version; all dependencies/other files immutable | manifest and uv dependency drift tests |
+| Adopt verified previous release child | Reset only a clean checkout after full attestation | actual Git remote recovery test |
+| Attest before/after rebase and before push | Validate remote before pull; validate resulting HEAD and clean worktree before push | push race drift/rebase tests |
+| #137 inspect every invocation and both notification arrays, even with empty results | Explicit notification shape and severity validation | CLI parameter matrix, later invocation/run tests |
+| Fail error/warning/missing level, malformed arrays/records | SARIF default warning; validate messages, descriptor and locations | missing/unknown/wrong type cases |
+| Allow valid note/none and print descriptor/location/message | JSON-escaped diagnostic context, no workflow commands | CLI diagnostics and informational cases |
+| Preserve ordinary unresolved findings gate | Retain existing all-findings rejection | existing regressions |
+| #138 single PR, all closing references, no deferral | Update #139 and changelog release trigger | final diff, clean tree, main ancestry, CI SHA |
+
+## Alternatives and source research
+
+- [SARIF 2.1.0 specification](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/sarif-v2.1.0.html)
+  defines notifications separately from results and the default warning level.
+- [Microsoft SARIF tutorial](https://github.com/microsoft/sarif-tutorials/blob/main/docs/3-Beyond-basics.md)
+  explains execution vs configuration notifications. Schema validation alone cannot
+  enforce this repository's policy that warnings invalidate extraction evidence.
+- [Tenacity](https://tenacity.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) provides bounded retries and
+  exponential waits; [urllib3 Retry](https://urllib3.readthedocs.io/en/stable/reference/urllib3.util.html)
+  handles HTTP clients, not Git subprocesses. Retain the small existing stdlib loop
+  instead of adding runtime dependencies for three attempts.
+- [GitHub rate-limit guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api)
+  recommends bounded exponential waits. Git stderr does not expose reliable response
+  headers, so use bounded waits for explicit 429/5xx, without guessing internal causes.
+- [sarif-tools](https://pypi.org/project/sarif-tools/) offers report processing;
+  it is unnecessary for the existing small JSON policy gate. Retain stdlib JSON.
+- [uv lock documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/layout/)
+  identifies uv.lock as TOML containing exact dependency resolution. Compare parsed
+  data, narrowly normalize the local package version, keep all dependency metadata.
+- Downstream #93 separates release recovery from transient retries; #166 checks
+  notifications independently of successful invocations. Adapt these concepts to
+  TOML and existing Python helpers rather than copying JavaScript.
+
+## Work sequence
+
+1. Add regressions and record failures on original implementation.
+2. Draft both fixes, source/lock attestation, workflow wiring and documentation.
+3. Run focused regressions and Ruff; commit atomic fixes and push only prepared branch.
+4. Review full PR diff; verify main ancestry, all current-SHA CI checks and logs.
+5. Update final test evidence, PR title/body with Fixes #138, Fixes #136, Fixes #137;
+   mark #139 ready. Keep PR unmerged.

+# Verification evidence
+
+## Original defects
+
+`python experiments/issue-138/reproduce_original.py` reads the original helpers
+at `78f2fdf5e085871387555bc066071f0aedd24479` using Git and mocks every release
+operation. `original-reproduction.log` records all four reproduced gaps:
+transient classification, hidden extraction errors, version-only recovery,
+and unvalidated rebase.
+
+## Focused automated checks
+
+- `pytest tests/test_release_integrity.py tests/test_version_and_commit.py -o addopts='' -q`: 106 passed.
+- `pytest tests/test_check_codeql_results.py -o addopts='' -q`: 75 passed.
+- `tests/test_release_workflow.py`: 27 passed in the focused verification run.
+- `ruff check scripts tests experiments/issue-138` and `ruff format --check scripts tests experiments/issue-138`: passed.
+- `python scripts/check_file_size.py` and `git diff --check`: passed.
+- `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python experiments/issue-138/verify_uv_lock.py`:
+  real uv 0.13.7 refreshes a finite dependency-free project lock offline;
+  only the local project version changes. No network or dependency builds.
+- The full test suite, builds, docs and workflow/security checks are exercised
+  by existing CI rather than duplicated locally.
+
+Release tests use small local repositories/bare remotes, parameterized for root
+and nested `python/` layouts. They cover matching/different-version source and
+lock drift, changes outside the package, file modes, fragments, validated-parent
+loss and merges, clean-checkout recovery, equivalent remote adoption, detached
+HEAD publication, failed rebase handling, and a second race during rebase.
+
+## CI investigation and correction
+
+The initial implementation commit `38e9071` ran at 2026-11-06 06:15:13 UTC.
+[Security run 42173259443](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/42173259443)
+failed both CodeQL gates because valid `level: "none"` success notifications
+contain `message: {"text": ""}`. This was a validator bug, not an extraction
+failure. The downloaded full log is preserved locally in
+`ci-logs/security-42173259443.log` (4987 lines); lines 2172 and 4524 show the
+Python and Actions success records that triggered the failure.
+
+The validator now accepts empty informational strings while retaining missing
+message/type/severity checks. Four CLI regressions cover both levels and both
+notification arrays. Both real SARIF artifacts from that run were downloaded
+and rechecked with the corrected gate: `Checked 2 CodeQL report(s): 0
+finding(s)/error(s).` The final PR description records current-commit CI results.
+
+Final review also bound push publication to `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` so a
+detached checkout publishes the attested commit rather than a stale local branch.
+No force push, rule bypass or release publication was performed during development.

+REF = "78f2fdf5e085871387555bc066071f0aedd24479"

+
+def original(name):
+    source = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "show", f"{REF}:scripts/{name}.py"],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,

+    module = types.ModuleType(name)

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Verify real uv lock refreshes alter only the local project version offline."""
+
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import tomllib
+from pathlib import Path
+
+uv = shutil.which("uv")
+if not uv:
+    raise SystemExit("Install uv before running this offline experiment")
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+    root = Path(directory)
+    manifest = root / "pyproject.toml"
+    manifest.write_text(
+        '[project]\nname = "Example_Project"\nversion = "1.0.0"\nrequires-python = ">=3.9"\n'
+    )
+    for version in ("1.0.0", "1.0.1"):
+        manifest.write_text(manifest.read_text().replace("1.0.0", version))
+        subprocess.run(
+            [uv, "lock", "--offline", "--python", sys.executable], cwd=root, check=True
+        )
+        shutil.copy2(root / "uv.lock", root / f"{version}.lock")
+    old = tomllib.loads((root / "1.0.0.lock").read_text())
+    new = tomllib.loads((root / "1.0.1.lock").read_text())
+    assert old["package"][0].pop("version") == "1.0.0"
+    assert new["package"][0].pop("version") == "1.0.1"
+    assert old == new
+    print("Verified: real uv offline refresh preserves all non-version lock content")

+    if git_text(["status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"]):

+def release_tree(ref: str) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:
+    """Inventory every tracked path, including its mode and blob/submodule SHA."""
+    entries = git_text(["ls-tree", "--full-tree", "-rz", ref]).split("\0")
+    tree = {}
+    for entry in entries:
+        if entry:
+            metadata, path = entry.split("\t", 1)
+            mode, _, oid = metadata.split()
+            tree[path] = (mode, oid)
+    return tree
+
+
+def normalized_manifest(ref: str, path: str) -> tuple[dict, str]:
+    """Ignore only project.version, never dependencies or other version keys."""
+    content = git_text(["show", f"{ref}:{path}"])
+    version = parse_version(content)
+    document = tomllib.loads(content)
+    del document["project"]["version"]
+    return document, version

+def normalized_lock(ref: str, path: str, manifest: dict, version: str) -> dict:
+    """Normalize only this project's uv package version, preserving resolution."""
+    document = tomllib.loads(git_text(["show", f"{ref}:{path}"]))
+    packages = document.get("package")
+    if not isinstance(packages, list):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid uv.lock package array")
+    own_packages = []
+    for package in packages:
+        if not isinstance(package, dict):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid uv.lock package")
+        project_name = re.sub(
+            r"[-_.]+", "-", manifest["project"].get("name", "")
+        ).lower()
+        if package.get("name") == project_name and package.get("source") in (
+            {"editable": "."},
+            {"virtual": "."},
+        ):
+            own_packages.append(package)
+    if len(own_packages) != 1 or own_packages[0].get("version") != version:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "uv.lock must contain exactly one matching local project version"
+        )
+    del own_packages[0]["version"]
+    return document

+def attest_release(validated_sha: str, candidate: str, manifest_path: str) -> None:
+    """Allow the validated commit or its sole metadata-only release child.
+
+    This is a full repository comparison, also for a package under python/.
+    A missing/replaced validated parent, merge, dependency drift, file-mode
+    change, or unrelated path fails closed and requires CI on the new revision.
+    """

+    root = Path(manifest_path).parent

+    changelog_path = (root / "CHANGELOG.md").as_posix()
+    fragment_dir = (root / "changelog.d").as_posix()
+    old_manifest, old_version = normalized_manifest(validated, manifest_path)
